_comment: Digests of every file vendored from envoir/crates/dmtap-sync-wasm.
Nothing in git ties a binary blob to the code that produced it, so this file does it explicitly:
provenance.test.js recomputes each SHA-256 and FAILS when a vendored byte does not match.
Update it only by re-running the sync recipe in ../VENDOR.md — never by pasting a new digest
to make the test go green, which would defeat the whole point.
Upstream's pkg/ is gitignored build output, so there is no upstream commit to pin; these
digests ARE the identity of this copy.
